DIAGNOSIS READY: DiGeorge Syndrome (22q11.2 deletion syndrome)

The presence of a continuous 'machinery' murmur suggests a patent ductus arteriosus or, more specifically in this context, a truncus arteriosus defect often associated with the syndrome. The combination of cataracts ('cloudy lenses'), failed hearing screening, and blanching-resistant skin lesions (potentially indicating vascular anomalies or hemangiomas) alongside the cardiac defect strongly points to this immunologic and developmental disorder.
